purpose: Regression for the real L-shaped house that previously lost physical roof faces when the selector filtered by 2x6 PV compatibility.
failureHistory: Only two compatible Google Solar segments were shown although the physical roof is L-shaped and has additional faces.
DP3 independently re-resolved the roof and represented the wrong house geometry.
DP6 received malformed/un-normalized image evidence in at least one test and OpenAI rejected the image payload.
Different DP pieces were allowed to construct different versions of the same site.
